chart_leg_findings: VALIDATE, and it is this voyage's keeper. THREE OF EIGHT CRITERIA NAMED AN INSTRUMENT THAT COULD NOT HAVE SHOWN WHAT THE CRITERION CLAIMED. (2) a text grep of staleness.py for 'mtime'/'ImportError' returns 16 and 5, from the module's own prose explaining which face a difference corresponds to and from the retired header comparison kept as reported-but-not-deciding payload — a grep cannot tell an explanation from a special case. (4) 'revert the predicate to HEAD and confirm direction one reds' cannot red anything, because test_discovery's prove-apart pair INJECTS the staleness answer instead of reading the real one. (1) `git stash` cannot make the HEAD-red tooth fail rather than error, because HEAD has no read_all at all and the proof file refuses at import. Each was replaced at the verdict — an AST walk of the deciding functions, a mutation of loop.py's own `if drifted:` branch, and a worktree plus a name-only shim — and each replacement is recorded beside the claim it answers. THE LEG-LEVEL FINDING: validate writes an instrument BEFORE the code exists, which is the whole point of the stage, but it means the instrument is never once executed at the moment it is authored. Nothing in the chain runs a criterion's instrument against the pre-build tree to see whether it can bite at all — and an instrument that cannot bite manufactures a hollow green, which Law 8 rates worse than a red.

DECOMPOSE — THE SAME MISS AS 2026-08-14, n=2 ON THE SAME COMPONENT. The split named a compose piece writing to cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/probes/loop_not_stale.py and NO piece for that probe's proof; the build wrote three new teeth into cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_loop_not_stale.py, a file the split never names and the survey never lists as a holding. The sibling voyage recorded exactly this shape ('the split named a piece for the probe and NO piece for the probe's proof') and shipped a watch that raised AttributeError the first time anything called it. It cost nothing this time only because the probe's proof already existed. A probe piece and its proof piece are not two decisions; the split treats them as one and drops the second.

HYPOTHESIZE — a magnitude prediction stated as an adjective and missed. H3 expected the objects the comparison cannot match to be 'a small, enumerable set'; measured over 172 held modules it is 364 of 1497, 24%. The falsifier as WRITTEN ('more than a handful of MODULES wholly undecidable') never came close to firing, so the hypothesis is confirmed by its own terms while the picture behind it was wrong. The pattern is the sibling voyage's H1 one rung along: a hypothesis whose falsifier measures a different quantity than the sentence predicts is a hypothesis that cannot be wrong.

SURVEY — the leg that paid for itself, recorded because a leg that WORKS is evidence too. Its fifth absence read 'Any need for a NEW probe berth. The cast named cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/probes/does_a_bench_name_the_right_culprit.py...' and its holdings already listed loop_not_stale.py. That absence is the entire reason a duplicate probe was not built, and it caught a defect the /sorted cast had already committed. The cast is the leg to feed: it named a berth without checking whether an existing probe's signature covered the condition, and the survey two stages later measured that it did.
